title: Petra and the Trail
author: Dominic Whitlock
blurb: Petra Quintana, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
